seo.title: ODDference — where business meets the creative sector
seo.description: A two-day conference for founders, creatives and policymakers who want to learn straight from the source. 11–12 June 2027, Helsinki.

title: Where business meets the creative sector.
intro: A two-day conference for founders, creatives and policymakers who want to learn straight from the source. Talks, matchmaking and a room full of the people actually building Finland's creative economy — followed by ODDfest, the open program it feeds straight into.

features.title: Talks & panels
features.body: Founders, creatives and policymakers on the same stage — not separate tracks.

features.title: Matchmaking
features.body: Structured time to meet the people worth meeting, not just business cards.

features.title: Straight into ODDfest
features.body: ODDference ends, ODDfest begins — same city, same crowd, open to everyone.
